</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/run/delete"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes 1 to 100 campaign runs at once, with their attack runs, results and traces: all of them or none. 404 if any id is not a campaign run visible to the caller, 409 if any of them or of their attack runs is still `PENDING` or `RUNNING` (cancel them first). This cannot be undone. Accepts a login token or an API key.
